name: ai.usesuperflow/superflow
description: Read website comments and AI review-agent findings, run review agents against a URL, and manage Superflow projects, analytics, and team access.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <Superflow personal access token>. Mint one in the Superflow portal under Settings > Integrations > Connected apps. Not required when the client completes the OAuth 2.1 flow instead.
